lead.headline: Nursing-home dialysis brands run 18 of 26 rated clinics flagged worse on survival, but only 9% worse than peers
lead.number: Dialyze Direct, Dialysis Direct and Concerto: 31 clinics, 18 of 26 rated flagged Worse on survival; their nursing-home residents die at 1.61x expected vs 1.48x at other nursing-home-heavy units, about 9% worse.
lead.watch_out: CMS's model under-predicts nursing-home deaths everywhere (1.18x expected), so these units start about 25% "worse" by construction; it's a class effect more than a brand effect.

Conclusions Despite a handicap of sicker patients at baseline, real-world application of MFD appears to hasten return to home from SNFs compared with CONVENTIONAL dialysis.
